_source: CBP ruling N341898 (22 Aug 2024): parent rolls of tissue paper made in Indonesia, embossed, cut to size, folded and packaged in China: CBP held Indonesia. A reverse probe: the target is China. In the D660 selection pool (substantial transformation, dated before 2026, in no development, held-out or tune-check split) and excluded. Target by the D171 rule; plant capabilities at the target are an assumption.

product.name: Paper napkins
product.description: Packages of tissue paper napkins in several sizes and folds, converted from parent rolls of 12-22 gsm tissue.
